name: Côtes de Bordeaux-Saint-Macaire

rules.yield_base: 55 hl/ha for dry white, 45 for moelleux, 37 for liquoreux

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.

blurb.text: A Bordeaux appellation in the Entre-Deux-Mers area, around Saint-Macaire and nine other communes. Its wines are made from Sémillon, Sauvignon, Sauvignon Gris and Muscadelle. Entre-Deux-Mers lies between the Garonne and Dordogne rivers.
